purpose: Pinned historical repository blobs used as immutable regression fixtures by tests/test_release_skill_onboarding.py. Committed here so fixture preparation never depends on git object availability: a partial (--filter=blob:none) CI checkout does not hold these blobs and made git lazily fetch them from the promisor remote mid-test (FAN-3848).
verify: From a full clone, every entry must satisfy: `git show <commit>:<path> | shasum -a 256` == sha256, and base64.b64decode(''.join(base64)) must hash to the same sha256.
